prompt: Edit this two-panel dumbbell farmer carry demonstration to correct walking form. Right: one short walking stride with feet still on two parallel hip-width tracks. DO NOT CROSS FEET OR LEGS and do not use a fashion runway stride. Torso upright, shoulders level, straight arms holding dumbbells steady at sides. Correct safe training demonstration. No text. Both panels must fit fully inside their own half.
